name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3
description: Thumb-sized ESP32-C3 board (21 × 17.8 mm, USB-C, RISC-V at 160 MHz) with Wi-Fi / BLE (not emulated), 4 MB flash, 11 GPIOs (D0 to D10), I2C, SPI and UART, and a built-in Li-ion charger (ETA4054, 380 mA) with BAT pads underneath. No user LED. Runs real arduino-esp32 firmware in Espressif's QEMU on your computer (Docker). Pin ids are GPIO numbers (GPIO2 = D0 …). 3.3 V logic only.

availability.reason: Its fixture test passed on 2026-11-11 (packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts, board seeed-xiao-esp32c3): real arduino-esp32 3.3.12 firmware built by Jumper's own pipeline boots in Espressif's QEMU; GPIO output, GPIO input with the internal pull-up, and Serial (UART0) reach Jumper's parts. Run on the merged jb5 emulator sources (a native QEMU build; the jumper/qemu-esp:9.2.2-20260417-jb5 Docker image itself is not built yet). Per-peripheral status: docs/boards.md.

pins.label: D0/A0
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO2; McuBackend pin "GPIO2" (pinMode(2, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D0 / A0 (ADC1). Strapping pin: must not be pulled LOW at reset (boot mode).

pins.label: D1/A1
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO3; McuBackend pin "GPIO3" (pinMode(3, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D1 / A1 (ADC1).

pins.label: D2/A2
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO4; McuBackend pin "GPIO4" (pinMode(4, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D2 / A2 (ADC1).

pins.label: D3/A3
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO5; McuBackend pin "GPIO5" (pinMode(5, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D3 / A3: ADC2 (analogRead is unreliable while Wi-Fi is on; prefer A0-A2).

pins.label: D4/SDA
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO6; McuBackend pin "GPIO6" (pinMode(6, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D4 / SDA: Wire SDA.

pins.label: D5/SCL
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO7; McuBackend pin "GPIO7" (pinMode(7, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D5 / SCL: Wire SCL.

pins.label: D6/TX
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO21; McuBackend pin "GPIO21" (pinMode(21, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D6 / TX: UART0 TX.

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: VBUS: 5 V from the USB-C port when plugged in (jumper.json power.usb). Without USB it is an input (4.5 to 5.5 V); on battery it stays at 0 V.

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground (all GND pins are one node).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board LDO (about 0.25 V dropout). Seeed rates it up to 500 mA (Jumper checks 500).

pins.label: D10/MOSI
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO10; McuBackend pin "GPIO10" (pinMode(10, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D10 / MOSI: SPI MOSI.

pins.label: D9/MISO
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO9; McuBackend pin "GPIO9" (pinMode(9, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D9 / MISO: SPI MISO. Strapping pin: LOW at reset = download mode (the BOOT button).

pins.label: D8/SCK
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO8; McuBackend pin "GPIO8" (pinMode(8, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D8 / SCK: SPI SCK. Strapping pin: must be HIGH for download mode.

pins.label: D7/RX
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO20; McuBackend pin "GPIO20" (pinMode(20, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D7 / RX: UART0 RX.

pins.label: BAT+
pins.description: Battery pad on the underside (+): a 1S LiPo / Li-ion cell. The board's ETA4054 charger charges it from USB at 380 mA (40 mA trickle below 2.9 V, CV at 4.2 V); use a cell of 380 mAh or more. Without USB the cell powers the board.

pins.label: BAT−
pins.description: Battery − pad on the underside. Same node as GND.

footprint: 21 × 17.8 mm castellated module, 2 × 7 pins at 0.1 in, rows 0.6 in apart, BAT pads underneath

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply wired to its power pins keeps the 3.3 V rail up; the firmware is held in reset while false.
True when this board runs the project's firmware (has an MCU backend).
The on-board ETA4054S2F charger is charging the cell on BAT (charge LED lit).
Digital level 0/1 of each GPIO, e.g. pin_GPIO2 (only on the firmware board).

strapping.note: GPIO2 (D0) must be HIGH or floating at reset, or the chip does not boot from flash.
GPIO8 (D8) must be HIGH at reset for USB / UART flashing; a part pulling it LOW makes uploads fail.
GPIO9 (D9) LOW at reset starts the ROM downloader instead of your program (that is what the BOOT button does).

toolchain.simNote: The simulator build sends Serial to UART0 (USB CDC On Boot: Disabled) and uses DIO flash; the factory pack builds the board's own settings (Serial on the USB-C port).

features.description: charge LED (lit while the battery charges)
U.FL connector for the external antenna (keep metal away)
